paragraphs: Peliti. R' Yaakov bar Peliti — Sukkah, chapter 2, halakhah 5.[^1][^2]

notes.text: פ״ב ה״ה gives chapter 2, halakhah 5, written out to avoid ambiguity with Mishnah numbering. The format suggests the Jerusalem Talmud, but the source does not name it. Earlier machine OCR had פ״! rather than the supplied פ״ב; this is not a verified printed variant. The abbreviated title remains R'.
This renders Hyman’s supplied citation; its occurrence and edition-specific locator have not been independently checked.
